## ICT Support Technician
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Location: Brisbane
Position: Full-time
Salary: $80,000 - $90,000

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and technically proficient Telecommunications Network Engineer to join our team and take ownership of the planning, design, implementation, and ongoing monitoring of complex telecommunications networks and broadcasting systems. The successful candidate will bring a strong engineering mindset, a methodical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across diverse hardware and software environments. This role suits an experienced professional who thrives in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment and is committed to delivering reliable, high-performance communications infrastructure.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, build, configure, and commission telecommunications devices, networks, and systems, ensuring seamless interoperability across equipment from multiple manufacturers, service providers, and end users
- Develop and present engineering project proposals that clearly define project goals, scope, background, justification, and estimated costs to support informed decision-making by stakeholders
- Evaluate, test, and procure new telecommunications products, services, and technologies, ensuring selections align with organisational requirements and long-term strategic objectives
- Identify, analyse, and diagnose faults and deficiencies within existing network systems, determining the most effective corrective measures to resolve current issues and prevent future disruptions
- Determine appropriate hardware and software configurations to achieve desired system performance, reliability, and scalability across all network environments
- Prepare, interpret, and maintain technical specifications, engineering drawings, and regulatory documentation to support the safe and compliant use of telecommunications equipment
- Determine the optimal type and arrangement of circuits, transformers, circuit-breakers, transmission lines, and associated infrastructure components
- Develop new network sites by conducting location assessments, preparing and lodging required documentation, producing technical drawings, and managing approvals through to completion
- Monitor network systems on an ongoing basis, proactively identifying performance anomalies and taking corrective action to maintain service continuity
- Assess current hardware and software performance levels to forecast future capacity needs, and develop short and long-term upgrade plans to enhance capability and system efficiency
- Ensure all telecommunications activities are carried out in full compliance with relevant Australian laws, regulations, industry standards, and internal policies and procedures
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contractors, and external vendors to deliver network projects on time, within scope, and to the required technical standard
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Demonstrated experience in the design, deployment, and management of telecommunications networks in a professional environment
- Proficiency in network protocols, transmission technologies, and telecommunications infrastructure, including fibre optic, microwave, and IP-based systems
- Strong understanding of relevant Australian telecommunications regulations, standards, and compliance frameworks
- Experience in preparing and interpreting technical specifications, engineering drawings, and project documentation
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond effectively to system issues
- Solid understanding of hardware and software configuration across diverse telecommunications platforms and vendor ecosystems
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex technical issues and develop practical solutions
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
- Valid Australian driver's licence (where site-based travel is required)
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor-neutral or vendor-specific credentials
- Experience with 4G/5G mobile network technologies and associated infrastructure
- Familiarity with SDN (Software-Defined Networking) and network virtualisation technologies
- Knowledge of broadcast and media transmission systems and associated engineering standards
- Previous experience working within utilities, government, or critical infrastructure environments
- Project management qualifications or experience, such as PRINCE2 or PMP certification
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation investing in next-generation telecommunications infrastructure, giving you exposure to cutting-edge technologies and large-scale engineering projects
- Enjoy a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values technical expertise, continuous improvement, and professional development
- Access ongoing training, industry certifications, and career progression pathways tailored to your engineering goals
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with opportunities for performance-based growth
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
